scope: Development smoke, manually authored before first ranking. One acceptable API per intent; no held-out or task-success claim.

critical_checks.rule: At least one baseline retrieves the expected API in Top-5; full card, source and docstring remain readable. Not multi-step knowledge sufficiency.
